inspection.detail: Header checks require exact dict, fixed required-field probes, exact key cardinality, schema and node-count types/range in frozen precedence. It does not copy or iterate arbitrary extra dictionary keys. Edge and change lists are exact builtins; collection lengths are checked before their contents. Every edge shape is checked before access, exact int before range/indexing, and duplicate detection follows frozen ordering.

All public admitted collection loops are bounded by fixed MAX_NODES, MAX_EDGES or MAX_PREDECESSORS after validation. Auxiliary pending/emitted/affected arrays use MAX_NODES. The duplicate-edge list has at most MAX_EDGES elements, each comparison is a pair of admitted bounded indices. No recursive call, network access, source fetch or authority decision occurs.

_topological_order maintains the count of un-emitted prerequisites for each node, emits the smallest available index, then decrements each outgoing required-to-dependent edge exactly when its required node is emitted. Failure to find a ready index returns None and public callers return only the appropriate cycle envelope. This covers every graph component, independently of the changed-node set.

reverse_reachable initializes seeds, processes dependents after every prerequisite in the complete topological order, and propagates only required-to-dependent edges. A node is marked only if seeded or some required node is marked; the sorted output enumerates declared indices only. The reasoning supports implementation inspection, not a machine-checked proof.

predecessor_order validates the full entry list before creating bounded edges; later-array predecessors are allowed. Reusing smallest-ready topological order implements the frozen tie rule and rejects disconnected cycles without returning a prefix.

Frozen original and addendum pins are enforced. Literal graph and predecessor cases pass in distinct identical development arms. Tests check exact output/error equality, input serialization nonmutation, separate result containers/lists, host tuple/dict-subclass rejection, and immunity of another/later result to result mutation.

The addendum preserves the original oracle and provides valid accepted exact-edge-limit graphs for both a required seed and a dependent seed. Their declared literal expected results agree with the graph relationships; the earlier inclusive-bound coverage gap is addressed.

Applicable isolated Python -Werror component tests and local syntax/function-size source check pass. CI contains the same isolated -Werror component test command. CI remote execution is not observed; the static tool is syntax/function-size checking, not formal verification or complete dynamic/static defect detection.
